Seneca

Quotes / Seneca / Q0035

English

He who has learned how to die has unlearned how to be a slave.
Thinker Seneca
School Stoicism
Source Letters to Lucilius, Ep. 26.10
Theme Death
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Letters to Lucilius, Ep. 26.10, within the tradition of Stoicism. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of death, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Seneca's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
